    : List mvcc.Change) (puts deletes putSize : w64) (crev : Int) (Z : IProp GF) (ld : Bool) (Tr :
    IProp GF) : mvcc.isTxnWriteT mw s γ trace ilog pend puts deletes putSize crev Z ld Tr ⊢ Tr ∗ ∀
    Tr', Tr' -∗ mvcc.isTxnWriteT mw s γ trace ilog pend puts deletes putSize crev Z ld Tr'

def mvcc.wsEndCb (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (ilog : mvcc.Log) (pend : List mvcc.Change) (crev : Int) (R :
    IProp GF) : IProp GF :=
  if pend = [] then mvcc.endCb γ.st ilog [] crev (mvcc.slotY γ.st ilog) R
  else
    iprop(mvcc.idxSealed γ.st.idx (ilog ++ [pend]) -∗
        mvcc.slotY γ.st ilog ∗ mvcc.wsSlot γ 1 ilog ={⊤}=∗
          mvcc.api.nlLb γ.st.api (ilog ++ [pend]) ∗
            ∃ Y, Y ∗ mvcc.endCb γ.st ilog pend crev Y iprop(mvcc.wsSlot γ 1 (ilog ++ [pend]) ∗ R))

            (DFrac.own 1) ∗
        "Htw" ∷ mvcc.storeTxnWriteCoreY tw s γ trace ilog pend chs ps sealed crev Z ld Y ∗ "Htrc" ∷ Tr)

    mvcc.endCb γ ilog [] crev Y R ⊣⊢ (mvcc.idxCert γ.idx ilog -∗ Y ={⊤}=∗ mvcc.slotY γ ilog ∗ R)

    match kind with | mvcc.TxnKind.read log rev => True | mvcc.TxnKind.write ilog pend puts deletes
    putSize => mvcc.writerFrag γ) ⊢ mvcc.txnEndPost γ kind

    mvcc.wsEndCb γ ilog [] crev R ⊣⊢ mvcc.endCb γ.st ilog [] crev (mvcc.slotY γ.st ilog) R

theorem mvcc.endCb_nil (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (ilog : mvcc.Log) (crev : Int) : ⊢ mvcc.endCb γ ilog []
    crev (mvcc.slotY γ ilog) iprop(True)

def mvcc.txnEndX (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (kind : mvcc.TxnKind) (crev : Int) (Y G R : IProp GF) : IProp
    GF :=
  match kind with
  | mvcc.TxnKind.read log rev => iprop(True)
  | mvcc.TxnKind.write ilog pend puts deletes putSize =>
    iprop(G ∗ □ (mvcc.slotF γ ∗ G -∗ False) ∗ mvcc.endCb γ ilog pend crev Y R)

    (pend : List mvcc.Change) (puts deletes putSize : w64) (chs : GoSlice) (ps : List Loc) (sealed :
    Bool) (crev : Int) (Z : IProp GF) (ld : Bool) : mvcc.isTxnWriteCore mw s γ trace ilog pend puts
    deletes putSize chs ps sealed crev Z ld = mvcc.isTxnWriteCoreY mw s γ trace ilog pend puts
    deletes putSize chs ps sealed crev Z ld (mvcc.slotY γ ilog)

theorem mvcc.muHeld_crevUB (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (c : Int) (ti : Loc) (q : Qp) (c' : Int)
    (h : -1 ≤ c') : mvcc.muHeld s γ c ti ∗ mvcc.crevUB γ.idx q c' ⊢ mvcc.muHeld s γ c ti ∗
    mvcc.crevUB γ.idx q c' ∗ ⌜c = c'⌝

    IProp GF) : ⊢ mvcc.txnEndX γ (mvcc.TxnKind.read log rev) crev Y G R

theorem mvcc.isTxnT_tr (mw s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (trace : Loc) (kind : mvcc.TxnKind) (crev
    : Int) (Z Tr : IProp GF) : mvcc.isTxnT mw s γ trace kind crev Z Tr ⊢ Tr ∗ ∀ Tr', Tr' -∗

theorem mvcc.isTxnWrite_toT (mw s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (trace : Loc) (ilog : mvcc.Log) (pend
    : List mvcc.Change) (puts deletes putSize : w64) (crev : Int) (Z : IProp GF) (ld : Bool) :
    mvcc.isTxnWrite mw s γ trace ilog pend puts deletes putSize crev Z ld ⊢ mvcc.isTxnWriteT mw s γ
    trace ilog pend puts deletes putSize crev Z ld iprop(∃ te, traceutil.ownTrace trace te)

def mvcc.isTxnEndY (mw s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (trace : Loc) (kind : mvcc.TxnKind) (crev :
    Int) (Z Y : IProp GF) (Tr : IProp GF := iprop(∃ te, traceutil.ownTrace trace te)) : IProp GF :=
  match kind with
  | mvcc.TxnKind.read log rev => mvcc.isTxnReadT mw s γ trace log rev crev Z Tr
  | mvcc.TxnKind.write ilog pend puts deletes putSize =>
    iprop(∃ chs ps sealed ld,
        mvcc.isTxnWriteCoreY mw s γ trace ilog pend puts deletes putSize chs ps sealed crev Z ld Y Tr)

def mvcc.endCb (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (ilog : mvcc.Log) (pend : List mvcc.Change) (crev : Int) (Y R :
    IProp GF) : IProp GF :=
  if pend = [] then iprop(mvcc.idxCert γ.idx ilog -∗ Y ={⊤}=∗ mvcc.slotY γ ilog ∗ R)
  else
    iprop(mvcc.idxCert γ.idx (ilog ++ [pend]) -∗
        mvcc.slotX γ 1 ilog crev ∗ Y ={⊤}=∗ mvcc.slotX γ 1 (ilog ++ [pend]) crev ∗ mvcc.slotY γ (ilog ++ [pend]) ∗ R)

def mvcc.txnEndPostH (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) : mvcc.TxnKind → IProp GF :=
  match x✝ with
  | mvcc.TxnKind.read log rev => iprop(True)
  | mvcc.TxnKind.write ilog pend puts deletes putSize =>
    iprop(mvcc.idxCert γ.idx (mvcc.commitLog ilog pend) ∗ mvcc.logQPost γ ilog pend)

def mvcc.isTxnReadT (mw s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (trace : Loc) (log : mvcc.Log) (rev : w64)
    (crev : Int) (Z Tr : IProp GF) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ p trw tr ti rt ranges,
      "Hmw" ∷
          typedPointsto mw
            {
              TxnWrite' :=
                interface.mkOk go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.txnReadWrite.ty.PointerType (intoVal trw),
              ranges' := ranges, puts' := W64 0, deletes' := W64 0, putSize' := W64 0 }
            (DFrac.own 1) ∗
        "Htrw" ∷
            typedPointsto
              (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.txnReadWrite
                go!"TxnRead" trw)
              (interface.mkOk go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.storeTxnRead.ty.PointerType (intoVal tr))
              (DFrac.own 1) ∗
          "#Hs" ∷ mvcc.isStore s γ ∗
            "#Htr" ∷ mvcc.storeTxnReadIs tr s rt trace (γ.withPhys p) log rev crev Z ∗
              "Hrd" ∷ mvcc.txReader (γ.withPhys p) rt log ∗
                "Hmu" ∷ mvcc.muHeld s (γ.withPhys p) crev ti ∗
                  "HrevMu" ∷ sync.ownRWMutex (mvcc.revMuAddr s) (mvcc.revMuInv s γ) ∗
                    "Hti" ∷ mvcc.idxReader ti (γ.withPhys p).idx ∗ "Htrc" ∷ Tr)

def mvcc.txnEndXPost (kind : mvcc.TxnKind) (G R : IProp GF) : IProp GF :=
  match kind with
  | mvcc.TxnKind.read log rev => iprop(True)
  | mvcc.TxnKind.write ilog pend puts deletes putSize => iprop(G ∗ R)

theorem mvcc.isTxnWriteCoreY_tr (mw s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (trace : Loc) (ilog : mvcc.Log)
    (pend : List mvcc.Change) (puts deletes putSize : w64) (chs : GoSlice) (ps : List Loc) (sealed :
    Bool) (crev : Int) (Z : IProp GF) (ld : Bool) (Y Tr : IProp GF) : mvcc.isTxnWriteCoreY mw s γ
    trace ilog pend puts deletes putSize chs ps sealed crev Z ld Y Tr ⊢ Tr ∗ ∀ Tr', Tr' -∗
    mvcc.isTxnWriteCoreY mw s γ trace ilog pend puts deletes putSize chs ps sealed crev Z ld Y Tr'

theorem mvcc.endCb_cons_iff (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (ilog : mvcc.Log) (pend : List mvcc.Change) (h :
    pend ≠ []) (crev : Int) (Y R : IProp GF) : mvcc.endCb γ ilog pend crev Y R ⊣⊢ (mvcc.idxCert
    γ.idx (ilog ++ [pend]) -∗ mvcc.slotX γ 1 ilog crev ∗ Y ={⊤}=∗ mvcc.slotX γ 1 (ilog ++ [pend])
    crev ∗ mvcc.slotY γ (ilog ++ [pend]) ∗ R)

theorem mvcc.isTxnWriteCore_takeY (mw s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (trace : Loc) (ilog : mvcc.Log)
    (pend : List mvcc.Change) (puts deletes putSize : w64) (chs : GoSlice) (ps : List Loc) (sealed :
    Bool) (crev : Int) (Z : IProp GF) (ld : Bool) : mvcc.isTxnWriteCore mw s γ trace ilog pend puts
    deletes putSize chs ps sealed crev Z ld ⊢ mvcc.slotY γ ilog ∗ ∀ Y, Y -∗ mvcc.isTxnWriteCoreY mw
    s γ trace ilog pend puts deletes putSize chs ps sealed crev Z ld Y

theorem mvcc.isTxnEnd_Y_read (mw s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (trace : Loc) (log : mvcc.Log) (rev
    : w64) (crev : Int) (Z Y : IProp GF) : mvcc.isTxnEnd mw s γ trace (mvcc.TxnKind.read log rev)
    crev Z ⊢ mvcc.isTxnEndY mw s γ trace (mvcc.TxnKind.read log rev) crev Z Y

theorem mvcc.isTxn_T (mw s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (trace : Loc) (kind : mvcc.TxnKind) (crev :
    Int) (Z : IProp GF) : mvcc.isTxn mw s γ trace kind crev Z = mvcc.isTxnT mw s γ trace kind crev Z
    iprop(∃ te, traceutil.ownTrace trace te)

theorem mvcc.isTxnReadT_rev (mw s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (trace : Loc) (log : mvcc.Log) (rev :
    w64) (crev : Int) (Z Tr : IProp GF) : mvcc.isTxnReadT mw s γ trace log rev crev Z Tr ⊢
    mvcc.isTxnReadT mw s γ trace log rev crev Z Tr ∗ ⌜rev = W64 (↑(List.length log) - 1)⌝

theorem mvcc.wsEndCb_cons_iff (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (ilog : mvcc.Log) (pend : List mvcc.Change) (h :
    pend ≠ []) (crev : Int) (R : IProp GF) : mvcc.wsEndCb γ ilog pend crev R ⊣⊢ (mvcc.idxSealed
    γ.st.idx (ilog ++ [pend]) -∗ mvcc.slotY γ.st ilog ∗ mvcc.wsSlot γ 1 ilog ={⊤}=∗ mvcc.api.nlLb
    γ.st.api (ilog ++ [pend]) ∗ ∃ Y, Y ∗ mvcc.endCb γ.st ilog pend crev Y iprop(mvcc.wsSlot γ 1
    (ilog ++ [pend]) ∗ R))

def mvcc.storeTxnWriteCoreY (tw s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (trace : Loc) (ilog : mvcc.Log) (pend
    : List mvcc.Change) (chs : GoSlice) (ps : List Loc) (sealed : Bool) (crev : Int) (Z : IProp GF)
    (ld : Bool) (Y : IProp GF) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ ti bt Locked ntok Pw fw Dep,
      "Htoks" ∷ ownTokAuthDfrac γ.revs (DFrac.own (Qp.half 1)) ntok ∗
        "%Hbudget" ∷ ⌜List.length ilog + ntok + 3 ≤ 2 ^ 63⌝ ∗
          "Htok" ∷ mvcc.revToken γ ∗
            "Htw" ∷
                typedPointsto tw
                  {
                    storeTxnCommon' :=
                      { s' := s, tx' := GoInterface.ok bt, firstRev' := W64 0, rev' := W64 0, trace' := trace },
                    tx' := GoInterface.ok bt, beginRev' := W64 (↑(List.length ilog) - 1), changes' := chs }
                  (DFrac.own 1) ∗
              "Hcap" ∷ ownSliceCap Loc chs (DFrac.own 1) ∗
                "%Hps" ∷ ⌜ps.length = pend.length ∧ ps.length = sint.nat chs.len ∧ 0 ≤ sint.Z chs.len⌝ ∗
                  "#Hs" ∷ mvcc.isStore s γ ∗
                    "#Hhook" ∷ mvcc.hookP γ Pw ∗
                      "#Hbt" ∷
                          mvcc.batchTxSpecG bt (mvcc.bucketView γ) (mvcc.storeRT γ) (mvcc.storeWT γ) (mvcc.storePutOk γ)
                            (mvcc.delKey γ) (mvcc.storeW s γ) Dep (mvcc.storeCmp γ) Locked Pw (mvcc.hookFn γ)
                            (mvcc.storeRb γ) (mvcc.kbMWv γ.kb γ.bucket) ∗
                        "#HbtB" ∷ mvcc.storeBt γ bt ∗
                          "#Hreg" ∷ mvcc.storeRegd s γ ∗
                            "Hrt" ∷ mvcc.storeRT γ ∗
                              "Hlocked" ∷
                                  mvcc.lockedIs ld bt (mvcc.bucketView γ) (mvcc.storeW s γ) Pw Locked
                                    (mvcc.pendPuts ilog pend) ∗
                                "Hw" ∷ mvcc.idxWriterB γ.idx ilog pend sealed ∗
                                  "Hclog" ∷ ghostVar γ.clog (Qp.half 1) ilog ∗
                                    "Hcur" ∷
                                        typedPointsto
                                          (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.store
                                            go!"currentRev" s)
                                          (W64 (↑(List.length ilog) - 1)) (DFrac.own (Qp.half 1)) ∗
                                      "Hbv" ∷ mvcc.bucketViewL γ mvcc.txQ ilog ∗
                                        "Hwv" ∷ ghostVar γ.wv 1 ilog ∗
                                          "HY" ∷ Y ∗
                                            "Htko" ∷ ownToks γ.tko 1 ∗
                                              "#Hcert" ∷ mvcc.idxCert γ.idx ilog ∗
                                                "%Hne" ∷ ⌜ilog ≠ []⌝ ∗
                                                  "Hmu" ∷ mvcc.muHeld s γ crev ti ∗
                                                    "HrevMu" ∷ sync.ownRWMutex (mvcc.revMuAddr s) (mvcc.revMuInv s γ) ∗
                                                      "Hti" ∷ mvcc.idxReader ti γ.idx ∗
                                                        "%Htrnn" ∷ ⌜trace ≠ null⌝ ∗
                                                          "Hcres" ∷
                                                              (mvcc.compactRes γ ilog ∗
                                                                mvcc.writerLoan γ ∗
                                                                  mvcc.wrToks γ (2 ^ 63 - 4 - List.length ilog) ilog) ∗
                                                            "Hlrd" ∷ lease.lessorRdOf γ.leases ∗
                                                              "%Hcrev" ∷ ⌜-1 ≤ crev ∧ crev < ↑(List.length ilog)⌝ ∗
                                                                "#HZ" ∷ □ Z)

theorem mvcc.isTxnEnd_Y (mw s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (trace : Loc) (kind : mvcc.TxnKind) (crev
    : Int) (Z : IProp GF) : mvcc.isTxnEnd mw s γ trace kind crev Z ⊢ mvcc.isTxnEndY mw s γ trace
    kind crev Z (match kind with | mvcc.TxnKind.read log rev => iprop(True) | mvcc.TxnKind.write
    ilog pend puts deletes putSize => mvcc.slotY γ ilog)

def mvcc.txnEndPreH (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) : mvcc.TxnKind → IProp GF :=
  match x✝ with
  | mvcc.TxnKind.read log rev => iprop(True)
  | mvcc.TxnKind.write ilog pend puts deletes putSize =>
    iprop(∃ P, mvcc.hookP γ P ∗ P ∗ mvcc.certOkNext γ ilog pend ∗ mvcc.logQPre γ ilog pend)

theorem mvcc.txnEndPreH_read (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (log : mvcc.Log) (rev : w64) : ⊢ mvcc.txnEndPreH
    γ (mvcc.TxnKind.read log rev)

def mvcc.isTxnWriteT (mw s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (trace : Loc) (ilog : mvcc.Log) (pend : List
    mvcc.Change) (puts deletes putSize : w64) (crev : Int) (Z : IProp GF) (ld : Bool) (Tr : IProp
    GF) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ tw ranges,
      "Hmw" ∷
          typedPointsto mw
            {
              TxnWrite' :=
                interface.mkOk go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.storeTxnWrite.ty.PointerType (intoVal tw),
              ranges' := ranges, puts' := puts, deletes' := deletes, putSize' := putSize }
            (DFrac.own 1) ∗
        "Htw" ∷ mvcc.storeTxnWriteIs tw s γ trace ilog pend crev Z ld ∗ "Htrc" ∷ Tr)

theorem mvcc.storeTxnWriteCore_Y (tw s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (trace : Loc) (ilog : mvcc.Log)
    (pend : List mvcc.Change) (chs : GoSlice) (ps : List Loc) (sealed : Bool) (crev : Int) (Z :
    IProp GF) (ld : Bool) : mvcc.storeTxnWriteCore tw s γ trace ilog pend chs ps sealed crev Z ld =
    mvcc.storeTxnWriteCoreY tw s γ trace ilog pend chs ps sealed crev Z ld (mvcc.slotY γ ilog)

theorem mvcc.slotF_excl_of (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (G : IProp GF) : mvcc.slotF γ ∗ G ∗ □ (mvcc.slotF γ
    ∗ G -∗ False) ⊢ False

theorem mvcc.isTxnWriteCoreY_core (mw s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (trace : Loc) (ilog : mvcc.Log)
    (pend : List mvcc.Change) (puts deletes putSize : w64) (chs : GoSlice) (ps : List Loc) (sealed :
    Bool) (crev : Int) (Z : IProp GF) (ld : Bool) : mvcc.isTxnWriteCoreY mw s γ trace ilog pend puts
    deletes putSize chs ps sealed crev Z ld (mvcc.slotY γ ilog) ⊢ mvcc.isTxnWriteCore mw s γ trace
    ilog pend puts deletes putSize chs ps sealed crev Z ld

def mvcc.isTxnT (mw s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (trace : Loc) (kind : mvcc.TxnKind) (crev : Int)
    (Z Tr : IProp GF) : IProp GF :=
  match kind with
  | mvcc.TxnKind.read log rev => mvcc.isTxnReadT mw s γ trace log rev crev Z Tr
  | mvcc.TxnKind.write ilog pend puts deletes putSize =>
    mvcc.isTxnWriteT mw s γ trace ilog pend puts deletes putSize crev Z false Tr

theorem mvcc.txnEndPre_H (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (kind : mvcc.TxnKind) : mvcc.txnEndPre γ kind ⊢
    mvcc.txnEndPreH γ kind ∗ match kind with | mvcc.TxnKind.read log rev => True |
    mvcc.TxnKind.write ilog pend puts deletes putSize => mvcc.writerFrag γ

theorem mvcc.isTxnRead_T (mw s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (trace : Loc) (log : mvcc.Log) (rev :
    w64) (crev : Int) (Z : IProp GF) : mvcc.isTxnRead mw s γ trace log rev crev Z = mvcc.isTxnReadT
    mw s γ trace log rev crev Z iprop(∃ te, traceutil.ownTrace trace te)

theorem mvcc.isTxnWrite_ofT (mw s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (trace : Loc) (ilog : mvcc.Log) (pend
    : List mvcc.Change) (puts deletes putSize : w64) (crev : Int) (Z : IProp GF) (ld : Bool) :
    mvcc.isTxnWriteT mw s γ trace ilog pend puts deletes putSize crev Z ld iprop(∃ te,
    traceutil.ownTrace trace te) ⊢ mvcc.isTxnWrite mw s γ trace ilog pend puts deletes putSize crev
    Z ld

theorem mvcc.isTxnRead_ofT (mw s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (trace : Loc) (log : mvcc.Log) (rev :
    w64) (crev : Int) (Z Tr : IProp GF) (te : Bool) : mvcc.isTxnReadT mw s γ trace log rev crev Z Tr
    ∗ traceutil.ownTrace trace te ⊢ mvcc.isTxnRead mw s γ trace log rev crev Z
